# UI scenes captured for visual review in CI and uploaded to Argos. Generated by wechat-ui/scenes/listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `npm --prefix wechat-ui run scenes:list` after changing them. A screenshot is named `<scene>@<viewport>`; viewports are
# `desktop` (1280x800), `narrow` (390x844), `compact` (320x700), joined by `+` for multiple sizes.
# Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
scene account-menu | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop | The account popover at the top of the rail, with its connection rows and sign-out.
scene add-contact | route /{server}/{account}/new-chat, viewports desktop+narrow | Server discovery and the greeting and privacy choices shown before a friend request is sent.
scene ai-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop+narrow | The AI chat panel, opened from the rail, with no service configured yet.
scene ai-sessions | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports narrow | The AI session list on a phone, with the new-conversation button and the archived section.
scene ai-settings | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports narrow | The AI service settings dialog on a phone, with its model and reasoning selects.
scene chat-filters | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop+compact | The conversation filter tabs, the collapsed service categories and their unread badges.
scene chat-info | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/info, viewports desktop+narrow | Details of a group conversation with its cached members and conversation flags.
scene chat-list | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop+narrow | The inbox with its filter tabs and unread badges, and the welcome pane beside it.
scene contact-details | route /{server}/{account}/contacts, viewports desktop+compact | A saved contact card with remark editing and relationship privacy, opened from the contact list.
scene contact-details-remove | route /{server}/{account}/contacts, viewports desktop+compact | The contact card's remove confirmation, which keeps chat history.
scene contacts | route /{server}/{account}/contacts, viewports desktop | The contact list of an account, grouped by contact kind.
scene desktop-hub-connect | route /servers, viewports desktop+narrow | The desktop app's hub picker, shown when no hub has been connected yet.
scene desktop-leftover-hub | route /servers, viewports desktop+narrow | The desktop app's first screen when a hub left running by an earlier session holds the local port.
scene desktop-settings | route /servers, viewports desktop+narrow | Desktop settings, including whether this device's hub keeps running while another hub is used.
scene direct-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | A direct conversation with text from both sides and a photo.
scene friend-request-review | route /{server}/{account}/contacts/requests, viewports desktop+narrow | One request opened from the inbox, with its greeting, history and accept action.
scene friend-requests | route /{server}/{account}/contacts/requests, viewports desktop+narrow | The friend-request inbox with received and sent requests and its direction tabs.
scene group-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop | A group conversation where each message names its sender, ending in a photo.
scene image-lightbox | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/media/{message}, viewports desktop+narrow | The photo viewer opened over a conversation, on the photo Mei sent.
scene login-qr | route /{server}/{account}/login, viewports desktop+narrow | Sign-in screen of an account that is not signed in, showing the QR code to scan.
scene message-deep-link | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/message/{message}, viewports desktop | A conversation opened at one message, which is scrolled into view.
scene new-chat | route /{server}/{account}/new-chat, viewports desktop | The dialog for starting a direct conversation, searching the contact list.
scene omni-search | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop | The ⌘K search dialog with contacts, groups and matching messages in separate sections.
scene quoted-replies | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | Quoted replies show the author name supplied with the quote above the quoted excerpt.
scene settings | route /{server}/{account}/settings, viewports desktop+narrow | The settings popover that opens from its button in the rail.
scene settings-category | route /{server}/{account}/settings, viewports narrow | A settings category opened from the directory on a phone, covering the tab bar.
